mapper.select: select count(*) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(o.pay_amount), 0.00) as totalAmount, ifnull(sum(o.pay_amount - ifnull(( select sum(i.cost_price * i.qty) from biz_order_item i where i.order_id = o.order_id ), 0.00)), 0.00) as grossMargin, count(distinct date(o.create_time)) as activeDays, max(o.create_time) as lastOrderTime from biz_order o where and o.create_time >= #{from} and o.create_time <= #{to}

select b.category_id as categoryId, ifnull(c.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, sum(i.share_amount) as amount from biz_order o join biz_order_item i on i.order_id = o.order_id left join biz_book b on b.book_id = i.book_id left join biz_category c on c.category_id = b.category_id where and o.create_time >= #{from} and o.create_time <= #{to} group by b.category_id, c.category_name order by amount desc

select case when hour(o.create_time) < 6 then '凌晨' when hour(o.create_time) < 12 then '上午' when hour(o.create_time) < 18 then '下午' else '晚间' end as period, count(*) as cnt from biz_order o where and o.create_time >= #{from} and o.create_time <= #{to} group by period

select o.member_id as memberId, timestampdiff(day, max(o.create_time), #{now}) as recencyDays, count(*) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(o.pay_amount), 0.00) as monetary from biz_order o where o.is_red = 0 and o.status in (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7) and o.member_id > 0 and o.create_time >= #{from} and o.create_time <= #{to} group by o.member_id
select sum(case when status in (1, 3) then 1 else 0 end) as borrowing, sum(case when status = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as overdue, count(*) as total from biz_borrow where member_id = #{memberId}
